page.overview:
Who is Ant?

The Ants appear in the episode "Storytelling." Finn finds them under a rock while he is looking for the "romance" part of the story for Jake. After Finn asks them whether they are in love, one of the ants begins to get angry and yells at him in a strange language, so Finn puts the rock back on top of them. The ant who spoke had a masculine voice and straighter antennae than the other, who was crying silently.
